title: Camps C18 — Save as template keeps the typing (the unsaved-changes guard)
subtitle: Rule v1.027 (the guard everywhere; rule v0.46): with a changed name, Esc, a click outside or Back keep the dialog open and show the shared note “Unsaved changes. Save or cancel first.” under the buttons — exactly as Camps’ Edit details, Edit payment and Add / Edit camp already do. On phones the note adds “Discard changes” (rule v0.56). With the name unchanged, Esc still just closes it. Admin, camp ⋯ → Save as template, name changed to “April Vacation Week”. Amber = what changes.

row.caption: … one Esc (or a click outside): the dialog closes and the typing is gone.

items.caption: PC. After Esc / a click outside the dialog stays; the amber note sits under Cancel / Save. Cancel or Save closes it.

footer: The note’s words and look are the shared ones already in Camps’ text (T.UNSAVED, T.DISCARD_CHANGES, from Color Belt). The walkthrough’s picture 17b #6 drew the PC note the same way. Script: mock-c18-guard.js.
